messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v2.14.3 -> staging (job 4821). logs: https://ci.redwood/4821 :rocket:
maria: heads-up, post-deploy parity check failed — schema validator rejected STAGING secret bundle. Error: missing key 'ENCRYPTED_KV_VERSION' :warning:
jorge: ah, that key is present in prod?
taylor: confirmed prod has ENCRYPTED_KV_VERSION set to 'v2'. staging seems to be on an older secret set (rotated last night but not pushed). :eyes:
maria: snippet from the check:
```json
{"secret_bundle": {"ENCRYPTED_KV_VERSION": null, "KMS_KEY":"projects/redwood/keys/infra"}}
```
elaine: how did staging skip the secret rotation? Was there a migration step tied to the release?
deploy-bot: Hook 'postdeploy:env-parity' returned 1. See job logs at https://ci.redwood/4821/logs#postdeploy_env_parity
sre-oncall: this explains the 502s seen in the staging smoke tests, we should not promote to prod.
jorge: +1. Propose we rollback staging to image sha: sha256:7f3b2a and hold the canary in prod. Anyone opposed?
taylor: fine to rollback staging. Also we should pin the helm chart imageTag in the release notes so next deploy doesn't pick `latest`-style tag. I'll open a tiny PR to pin -> https://git.redwood/infra/helm/releases/pull/912 :thumbsup:
maria: quick mitigation: we can patch staging secret to match prod until rotation is fixed, but that masks the real bug. I'd prefer rollback and re-run rotation pipeline with explicit secret bundle publish.
sre-oncall: agree with rollback + re-run rotation. Set a change window: 30min from now (15:00-15:30 PDT) to avoid overlapping with data team ETL.
elaine: leaving a note in release notes: "Hold promotion: staging secret bundle incompatible with prod (ENCRYPTED_KV_VERSION mismatch). Rollback applied to staging, rotation pipeline re-run, do not promote until green)" Link: https://notes.redwood/release/v2.14.3/hold
jorge: I'll apply the rollback now. Deploy-bot, please mark release as 'on-hold' and annotate with the job id and failing check.
deploy-bot: Marked release v2.14.3 as ON_HOLD (reason: env-parity check failure - missing ENCRYPTED_KV_VERSION). Annotations added: job=4821, check=postdeploy:env-parity.
maria: after rollback I'll run the rotation job locally and push a validated secret bundle (will post checksum).
taylor: also adding an explicit checklist item in the release template: "verify secret bundle version equals prod before promote".
sre-oncall: once rotation validated, we'll rerun the staging deploy in the change window and then run end-to-end smoke. If green, promote to prod with a pinned image tag.
maria: checksum for the validated secret bundle: sha1: d3b07384d113edec49eaa6238ad5ff00. posting to internal secrets audit channel once pushed. :white_check_mark:
elaine: thanks all. Filing a short postmortem note and update to the helm values docs to avoid unpinned tags slipping through.
jorge: closing the loop: rollback done, staging smoke is back to green, rotation queued for 15:05 PDT. Will update thread when rotation completes. :rocket:
